commits.message: One frame per colour depth; pause is pinned at sixty frames a second over a tenth of a second; the rate and frame checks say what they read (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
One writtenOver check: what a window wrote must hold a gallery frame, and a depth rebuild must keep 1 fps (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
The no-color checks require a painted frame, so an empty window cannot pass them (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
The colour-depth and pause playground tests play at one frame a second, so they no longer paint hundreds of unread gallery frames (rich-palette-xovz.u60)

Clipboard, pointer and notification are chosen by pick over the console's TerminalFeatures: one fact for layers and terminal, passthrough evidence weighed, the route in the send log (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.a28)

Terminal features chosen by capability; Progress mirrors OSC 9;4 (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.stc) (#596)

* A program's terminal features are chosen by capability: evidence, policy and layers decide each send, and a Progress mirrors OSC 9;4 (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.stc)

TerminalCapabilities carries how each fact is known (declared, confirmed,
identified, inferred, unknown); pick chooses the first encoding the policy
accepts and every layer passes, or falls back, and says why. The painter
Live and App share owns what the terminal is believed to hold, commits each
frame's declarations, and restores on hand-back; every decision, those that
send nothing included, reaches TerminalFeatures.onSend.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Review fixes: route wraps outermost-first, painter returns its terminal bytes with the frame, a frame drops undrawn declarations, TERM_PROGRAM lookup ignores prototype keys (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.stc)

* Medium-review fixes: an App's Progress reaches OSC 9;4 again, a host off a terminal gets none of it, a native layer refuses another's envelope, an inherited LC_TERMINAL yields to a terminal's own TERM_PROGRAM (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.stc)

* Second high-review fixes: screen refuses to carry tmux's envelope, a passthrough's trust is weighed by the drop it risks, onSend runs while the painter matches the terminal, one percent rule for change and bytes, kitty's TERM yields an inherited TERM_PROGRAM, wire constants in one module (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.stc)

* The send-log example prints through a Console the docs terminal records, and the layers section says which stacks cannot be wrapped (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.stc)
